prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic architectural high-fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman in a raw concrete interior.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with a sleek dark bob, composed expression, natural skin texture, black tailored blazer and supplied black structured fashion bodysuit. Preserve the feminine silhouette, geometric tailoring and confident posture shown in the reference.
composition_elements: Subject stands behind or leans against a rectangular raw-concrete block with hands resting on its top edge.
Brutalist concrete walls, ceiling planes and a sharp skylight beam create geometric framing and strong negative space.
Preserve the black-on-gray palette, short bob, concrete texture and architectural hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Directional daylight from the skylight with hard geometric shadow edges, controlled bounce fill, and cinematic neutral contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 1:1 portrait, Hasselblad H6D-100c with 80mm lens at f/5.6, sharp textile and concrete detail, visible pores, subtle grain, restrained gray grade, no text or watermark.
